business_description: An independent specialty sporting goods retailer with two store locations in suburban Ohio, generating roughly $1.8M in annual sales with approximately 55% of revenue occurring in the October–December holiday season.
key_risk_narrative: Revenue is heavily concentrated in the Q4 holiday window, creating a liquidity squeeze in Q1–Q2; internally prepared financials lack CPA validation and the owner's year-end inventory counts are the sole basis for COGS.
discrepancy_description: Tax return reports gross sales of $1,820,000, but annualised bank deposits across two business accounts total $1,490,000 — an 18% shortfall suggesting either unreported cash sales deposited elsewhere or significant uncollected receivables.
